limits: A targeted cancellation diagnostic, not a representative whole-language workload or general speedup claim.
No compiler wall-time improvement claimed. Single pass timings were noisy; pass-work counts are deterministic accounting, not time.
The transformation applies only to checked signed-i64 opcodes, not unsigned/IEEE Numeric operations.
Operand producers still execute, including calls and trapping arithmetic. x/x, x%x and x%-1 are not admitted identities.
Native and C11 executable sizes were unchanged (51672 and51712 bytes respectively); assembly reduction did not reduce these linked file sizes.
Timing samples include startup and the original host polling granularity; this is not kernel-only latency or statistical significance evidence.
